What you get

Routine changes, made by your team.

Most website changes are small and urgent. A price, a phone number, a photo. You should not have to wait a week for them.

01

Make routine updates yourself

Change prices, phone numbers, text, images and buttons without waiting for a developer.

02

Keep your current website

The Builder works with the website you already have. It does not replace your design or move you to another platform.

03

Review before publishing

Changes stay in draft until you approve them. You see what changed before it reaches the live site.

04

Restore earlier versions

Every publish is recorded. You can return to an earlier version when you need to.

Also in the editor

  • Desktop, tablet and phone views. Change a style for phones only when you need to.
  • Shared headers, footers and buttons. Edit once, and see how many pages the change reaches first.
  • Plain-language labels. You see “Main heading”, not code.
  • Image crop and focal point, with a preview before you use a new image.
  • A live check after publishing. The Builder tells you when the change is visible on your site.
  • Protection against overwrites. If someone else changed the same thing, you see both versions.

Trust and safety

Safe to hand to your team.

  • Your existing site stays intact. The Builder edits your current pages. It does not rebuild them.
  • Nothing goes live until someone on your team presses Publish.
  • Every publish is versioned, so any earlier version can be restored.
  • Repository access covers only the repository you choose. You can remove it at any time.
  • Paystack handles card payments. Dakyworld never receives or stores your card details.
  • If you cancel, your website stays online until the end of the period you paid for.
Compatibility

Know what works before you rely on it.

Every website is partly editable. During setup we give you a compatibility report on your actual site, so the limits are agreed before your team starts.

Works well

Static websites, websites Dakyworld built, and GitHub-backed sites where page content can be traced to editable source. Headings, text, links, buttons, images and their styles are all editable.

Editable, with limits

Menus, sliders and other parts driven by code will not behave in the editor as they do live. Your changes still publish correctly.

Stays with your developer

What a form does when submitted, embedded maps and videos, and custom components. The words around them are still yours to edit.

Not supported

WordPress and Shopify, as a full visual editing experience. Pages that only exist once an application runs in the browser.

Built with React, Next.js, Astro, Vue, Nuxt or SvelteKit? You can edit the words, links and image details in your source files, with a review before each change is saved. There is no live visual canvas for these sites.

Technical detail for framework and AI-built sites+

Pages are listed from your route files. Sites built with tools such as Lovable or Bolt are read the same way. Blocks can be moved, copied, restyled or removed, with separate styles for tablet and phone. Your published page is shown beside the fields as you work.

Named fields stay editable when other files contain the same words. Text built entirely from fixed strings is editable too. Text calculated from live data still has to be changed in its source.

We edit the file and do not build your project. Your host rebuilds it after each publish, and the preview updates when that rebuild finishes.

Common questions

Before you hand it to your team.

Can we break the website?+

Not easily. You edit content and styles, not code, so the layout is hard to damage by accident. Nothing goes live until you publish, and any earlier version can be restored.

Does our developer lose anything?+

No. The Builder saves changes to the same files your developer uses, as normal commits. If your developer changes a page you are editing, the Builder shows both versions instead of overwriting either.

What access do you need?+

Read and write access to the one repository your website lives in, and nothing else. You grant it by installing a GitHub app, and you can remove it at any time. If Dakyworld hosts your site, there is no repository to connect.

How long until a change is live?+

Usually under two minutes. Your host rebuilds the site after each publish. The Builder watches your live page and tells you when the change is visible.

Is there a limit on edits?+

Website Builder includes up to 30 saved edits a month and 50 MB of image storage. Website Care + Builder includes up to 200 edits and 500 MB. Business has no edit limit and 5 GB.

Can two people edit at once?+

Yes. If two people change the same thing, the second save is stopped and both versions are shown so someone can choose.

Do we need to be technical?+

No. Everything is labelled in plain language. The one technical step, connecting your website, happens once and we guide you through it.

What happens if we cancel?+

You can cancel from inside the editor, and your website stays online until the end of the paid period. Changes published to your own repository stay there. If we host your site, you can export your pages and version history. Your domain is always yours.
